Potential_Impact: Changes in input data may reduce the reliability of model predictions.
Response_Action: Investigate the affected features, review data sources, and evaluate model performance before considering retraining.

Detection_Method: Performance monitoring using actual customer outcomes
Potential_Impact: The model may produce less accurate churn predictions.
Response_Action: Investigate the cause, review recent data, and evaluate whether model retraining is required.

Potential_Impact: Some customer groups may receive less reliable predictions.
Response_Action: Investigate performance differences and review data and model behavior before further use.

Detection_Method: Security alerts or reported unauthorized data exposure
Potential_Impact: Customer information may be exposed or accessed without authorization.
Response_Action: Restrict affected access, investigate the incident, preserve relevant records, and follow applicable data breach procedures.

Potential_Impact: Unauthorized users may access system components, models, or sensitive information.
Response_Action: Block unauthorized access, review access permissions, and investigate affected system components.

Potential_Impact: Business decisions may rely entirely on predictions without appropriate human review.
Response_Action: Review the affected decisions, reinforce human oversight requirements, and clarify the limitations of model predictions.
